description: Kohinoor Power Company Limited generates and sells electric power from a 15 MW furnace-oil-fired station, with WAPDA as its sole customer. The company was incorporated in 1991 and converted to a public limited company in 1992; its memorandum also permits leasing out its machinery and buildings under operating leases.
headOffice: 1O-G, Mushtaq Ahmed Gurmani Road, Gulberg-II, Lahore, Pakistan
sourceNote: Company website (kpcl.com.pk: home) and the PSX company profile record, read 2026-10-17. No telephone number is published on either.
